theorems.name: Submission.chart_tangential_coefficient_trace_identity
theorems.statement: ∀ (n N : ℕ) (V : Set (Rn n)) (ψ : Rn n → Rn N) (u : Rn n → Rn N), IsOpen V → ContDiffOn ℝ 2 ψ V → (∀ x ∈ V, Function.Injective (fderiv ℝ ψ x)) → ContDiffOn ℝ 1 u V → let a : Rn n → Rn n := fun x ↦ Ring.inverse (ContinuousLinearMap.adjoint (fderiv ℝ ψ x) ∘L fderiv ℝ ψ x) (ContinuousLinearMap.adjoint (fderiv ℝ ψ x) (u x)); ∀ x ∈ V, LinearMap.trace ℝ (Rn n) (fderiv ℝ a x).toLinearMap + LinearMap.trace ℝ (Rn n) (Ring.inverse (ContinuousLinearMap.adjoint (fderiv ℝ ψ x) ∘L fderiv ℝ ψ x) ∘L ContinuousLinearMap.adjoint (fderiv ℝ ψ x) ∘L fderiv ℝ (fderiv ℝ ψ) x (a x)).toLinearMap = LinearMap.trace ℝ (Rn n) (Ring.inverse (ContinuousLinearMap.adjoint (fderiv ℝ ψ x) ∘L fderiv ℝ ψ x) ∘L ContinuousLinearMap.adjoint (fderiv ℝ ψ x) ∘L fderiv ℝ u x).toLinearMap + inner ℝ (u x - fderiv ℝ ψ x (a x)) (∑ l : Fin n, fderiv ℝ (fderiv ℝ ψ) x (EuclideanSpace.single l 1) (Ring.inverse (ContinuousLinearMap.adjoint (fderiv ℝ ψ x) ∘L fderiv ℝ ψ x) (EuclideanSpace.single l 1)))
